convert_mm_grounding_dino_checkpoint: convert an mm_grounding_dino checkpoint to HuggingFace format with optional verification and hub upload
get_mm_grounding_dino_config: get an MMGroundingDinoConfig for a given model variant (tiny, base, or large)
get_mm_grounding_dino_processor: get a GroundingDinoProcessor with image and tokenizer components
convert_mm_to_hf_state: convert an mm_grounding_dino state dict to HuggingFace model state dict format
run_convert_cli: run the convert_mm_grounding_dino_to_hf CLI script with model name and optional flags
